fact: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and SMEs of Guinea says its Secretary General chaired a review session on the draft startup law on 29 April 2025, with the higher education and posts and telecommunications ministries.
system: Projet de loi sur les Startups

fact: Lengo Pay's director general Ibrahima Diallo, quoted by Business 360, notes the absence of a Startup Act in Guinea, unlike Senegal, Cote d'Ivoire and Tunisia.
Guinee Alliance Startup reminds the authorities of the urgency of getting the draft Startup Act bill ('projet de loi Startup Act') passed.
Guinee Startup Alliance reports a ministry workshop on 8 April 2025 reviewed and pre-validated the draft Startup Act, with tax relief for labelled startups and a four-year support fund.
